title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Acts 6: seven men chosen to serve, the word of God spreading, and the charges brought against Stephen.

questions.text: What was the complaint of the Hellenists against the Hebrews?
questions.explanation: A complaint arose because the widows of the Hellenists were neglected in the daily service.

answers.text: That the apostles taught too little
That their widows were neglected in the daily service
That they were not allowed in the temple
That the priests opposed them

questions.text: What did the twelve say was not appropriate for them?
questions.explanation: The twelve said it was not appropriate for them to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

answers.text: To forsake the word of God and serve tables
To take gifts from the multitude
To appoint men over this business
To leave Jerusalem for other cities

questions.text: How many men were the disciples to select?
questions.explanation: They were to select seven men of good report from among themselves.

answers.text: Twelve
Three
Seven
Seventy

questions.text: What were these men to be?
questions.explanation: They were to be men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, appointed over this business.

answers.text: Men chosen from the priestly families of Jerusalem
Men taught by the scribes of the council
Men from the city of Antioch only
Men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom

questions.text: What did the twelve say they would continue in?
questions.explanation: They said they would continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.

answers.text: In the daily service of tables
In prayer and in the ministry of the word
In signs and wonders
In teaching in the synagogues

questions.text: Who is named first among the men they chose?
questions.explanation: They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and then Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas and Nicolaus.

answers.text: Stephen
Philip
Nicanor
Parmenas

questions.text: What is Nicolaus called in the list of the seven?
questions.explanation: Nicolaus is called a proselyte of Antioch.

answers.text: A Levite of Cyprus
A teacher of the law
A man of Tarsus
A proselyte of Antioch

questions.text: Which group is said to have been obedient to the faith in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The word of God increased, the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem, and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

answers.text: A great company of the Sadducees
The elders and the scribes
A great company of the priests
The whole council

questions.text: What did the men who were secretly induced claim to have heard Stephen say?
questions.explanation: They were induced to say that they had heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.

answers.text: Blasphemous words against Moses and God
Words against the Roman rulers
A promise to rebuild the temple
Teaching about a new law

questions.text: What did all who sat in the council see when they fastened their eyes on Stephen?
questions.explanation: All who sat in the council saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

answers.text: That he was trembling with fear
That he kept silent
That his face was like the face of an angel
That he was praying with his eyes closed
